metrics.failure_policy: Failed requests contribute no predictions (GT remains); metrics are marked incomplete.
metrics.image_accuracy_policy: All evaluated images form the denominator, including inference failures. Correct requires a successful request, class-aware one-to-one matches for every GT box and zero FP/FN at configured IoU/score/max-detection settings. An inference failure is always an incorrect image, even for empty GT.
metrics.unlabeled_policy: Infer all images. Missing GT follows the configured policy: negative uses empty GT; skip excludes from metrics; error stops before inference.
metrics.negative_metric_policy: Image-level FP rate at score_threshold, capped per class; denominator excludes failed negative images. Failures are not true negatives and mark evaluation incomplete.
metrics.negative_error_policy: (Negative FP images + failed negative images) / all evaluated negative images. Every failed negative is an error and remains in the denominator.

timing.policy: Per-image wall time includes preprocessing and retries; excludes setup/cache hits. Sum of concurrent request latencies is not end-to-end throughput.

run.protocol: Frozen 300-image cohorts. YOLOE uses exactly the PET-DINO 1/5/10-shot supports, boxes and seed=0. GroundingDINO uses verbatim WeDetect Chinese prompts. Every class queries every image; class-labelled predictions are merged without cross-class NMS. Candidate floor=0.001, NMS IoU=0.7, maxDets=100/class, evaluation IoU=0.5 and score=0.5. Model-native preprocessing and feature aggregation are retained. Fresh inference; no training/API calls.

metrics.method: Class-aware bbox, score-ranked greedy one-to-one matching, COCO-style 101-point AP, all areas, no crowd/ignore. AP uses all confidence scores; score_threshold affects only precision/recall/F1 and proxy loss. Classes without GT excluded from mAP.

loss.definition: Hungarian mean normalized xyxy L1 + mean (1-IoU) + FP/(TP+FP) + FN/(TP+FN); weighted sum. Localization pairing is class-aware and does not require an IoU threshold. No backpropagation.
